fieldValues.title: An agent pointed at the published specification cannot read it
fieldValues.statement: The specification is published at srs.semanticops.com as one 514 KB markdown file with no index for agents. A web-fetch tool stops after about 117,000 characters, so an agent reaches only the opening parts and cannot find, for example, what ext:addressability requires; the full form is an .srs archive it cannot open without an SRS client. A third party who points an AI assistant at the standard cannot learn it or use it correctly.
